prompts.label: First Android Studio project (Java)
prompts.text:
I'm new to Android with Java. Guide me to create the first app in Android Studio.

- New project: Empty Views Activity, Java language, minimum SDK reasonable for beginners
- Explain app/, res/layout, AndroidManifest.xml, MainActivity.java
- Run on emulator or device
- Change TextView to Hello Android

Use current Android Studio Hedgehog+ wording. List key files only.

prompts.label: Activity lifecycle onCreate onDestroy
prompts.text:
Teach Activity lifecycle for a beginner Java app.

- Override onCreate, onStart, onResume, onPause, onStop, onDestroy with Log.d tags
- Explain what runs when app opens, rotates, goes background
- Mention configChanges only as optional reading

Single MainActivity.java with lifecycle logging exercise.

prompts.label: LinearLayout and ConstraintLayout XML
prompts.text:
Build a login screen layout in XML using LinearLayout or ConstraintLayout.

- EditText username/password, Button login, TextView error placeholder
- Use match_parent/wrap_content and margins dp
- Wire views in MainActivity with findViewById

Provide activity_main.xml snippet and minimal Java click handler.

prompts.label: ViewBinding instead of findViewById
prompts.text:
Migrate a simple screen from findViewById to ViewBinding.

- Enable viewBinding in build.gradle module
- Inflate ActivityMainBinding in onCreate
- Access views via binding.textView syntax
- Explain null safety and when binding is preferred

Before/after comparison in 4 bullets.

prompts.label: Explicit Intent open second Activity
prompts.text:
Create MainActivity and DetailActivity with explicit Intent.

- Button passes item id via putExtra
- DetailActivity reads getIntent extras in onCreate
- Register activity in AndroidManifest
- Finish DetailActivity with back stack behavior explained

Full Java for both activities.

prompts.label: Implicit Intent share text
prompts.text:
Show implicit Intent to share plain text from my app.

- Intent.createChooser with ACTION_SEND and text/plain
- Explain why chooser is user-friendly
- Contrast explicit vs implicit in 3 bullets
- Handle ActivityNotFoundException gracefully

Minimal share button handler in Java.

prompts.label: RecyclerView list adapter
prompts.text:
Build a RecyclerView list of items (title + subtitle) in Java.

- item_row.xml row layout
- Adapter extending RecyclerView.Adapter with ViewHolder
- LinearLayoutManager in Activity
- Fake in-memory List<Item> data source

Explain ViewHolder recycling at beginner level.

prompts.label: Fragment in FrameLayout
prompts.text:
Introduce Fragments with one ListFragment and one DetailFragment placeholder.

- activity hosts FrameLayout container
- replace fragment with FragmentManager transaction
- Pass arguments via Bundle setArguments
- Explain why fragments matter for tablets/navigation

Java only; no Navigation Component yet.

prompts.label: SharedPreferences save settings
prompts.text:
Persist a username toggle and dark mode flag with SharedPreferences.

- getSharedPreferences name and MODE_PRIVATE
- edit().putBoolean().apply()
- Read on startup to restore UI
- Warn what SharedPreferences is not for (large data)

Small settings screen example.

prompts.label: Room database Java entity DAO
prompts.text:
Set up Room in a Java Android app for a Note entity.

- @Entity, @Dao with insert and getAll LiveData or List
- @Database abstract class
- Allow main thread queries false; use background thread or executor note
- Gradle dependencies for room-runtime, compiler annotationProcessor

Minimal CRUD flow described step by step.

prompts.label: Retrofit GET JSON list
prompts.text:
Fetch a JSON list from a public API with Retrofit in Java.

- Interface ApiService with @GET
- Gson converter factory, Retrofit.Builder baseUrl
- Call enqueue Callback on background thread
- Update RecyclerView on main thread via runOnUiThread

Use https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/posts or similar.

prompts.label: ViewModel and LiveData pattern
prompts.text:
Introduce ViewModel + LiveData for a counter or todo list in Java.

- ViewModel holds MutableLiveData
- Activity observes with getViewModel() lifecycle owner
- Explain rotation survival benefit vs storing in Activity field
- No Kotlin coroutines — Java only

Use androidx.lifecycle artifacts.

prompts.label: Navigation Component graph
prompts.text:
Wire Jetpack Navigation with nav_graph.xml and NavHostFragment.

- Two destinations Home and Settings fragments
- BottomNavigationView or buttons triggering NavController.navigate
- Safe Args mention optional
- Compare to manual Fragment transactions briefly

Java fragments and MainActivity hosting NavHost.

prompts.label: Material Toolbar and menu
prompts.text:
Add MaterialToolbar as app bar with options menu.

- menu/main_menu.xml with search and settings items
- onCreateOptionsMenu and onOptionsItemSelected in Java
- setSupportActionBar(toolbar)
- Theme MaterialComponents.DayNight

Explain overflow menu on small screens.

prompts.label: Runtime permissions camera or location
prompts.text:
Request dangerous permission at runtime using modern Activity Result API.

- Check ContextCompat.checkSelfPermission
- registerForActivityResult RequestPermission launcher
- Show rationale dialog pattern if shouldShowRequestPermissionRationale
- Pick CAMERA or ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION as example

Explain manifest declaration still required.

prompts.label: Foreground Service basics
prompts.text:
Sketch a Foreground Service playing a long task with persistent notification.

- StartForeground with notification channel (Android 8+)
- Service class extending Service, return START_STICKY briefly
- Stop service action on notification
- Warn about background execution limits on modern Android

Conceptual Java; note WorkManager alternative for deferrable jobs.

prompts.label: Notification channel and builder
prompts.text:
Create a notification channel and show a simple notification from a button click.

- NotificationManager createNotificationChannel
- NotificationCompat.Builder with icon, title, content intent PendingIntent
- POST_NOTIFICATIONS permission on Android 13+
- Tap opens MainActivity

Java code in Activity.

prompts.label: Gradle build types debug release
prompts.text:
Explain buildTypes debug vs release in app build.gradle for Java Android project.

- minifyEnabled false for beginners; mention ProGuard when true
- signingConfigs concept without real keystore secrets
- Build Variants window in Android Studio
- applicationId vs namespace note briefly

Checklist before publishing to Play Console.

prompts.label: Espresso UI test one screen
prompts.text:
Write one Espresso test clicking a button and asserting TextView text changes.

- androidTest dependency androidx.test.espresso
- ActivityScenarioRule or ActivityScenario launch
- onView(withId).perform(click); check(matches(withText()))
- Run from Android Studio test runner

Explain unit test vs instrumented test folders.

prompts.label: MVP pattern sketch in Java
prompts.text:
Refactor a login screen toward MVP for learning.

- LoginContract with View and Presenter interfaces
- Presenter validates input, View shows errors
- Activity implements View interface
- Contrast MVP vs MVVM with LiveData in 4 bullets

Keep scope tiny; no Dagger yet — manual construction.
